FIELDS.NAME: Elegant Spaces Interior Design
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Spaces Interior Design specializes in personalized interior design and decoration services, focusing exclusively on residential spaces. Our operations include consulting with clients to understand their vision, creating tailored design plans, and sourcing materials and furnishings from trusted vendors. We ensure that our designs are not only aesthetically pleasing but also functional, adhering to local building codes and industry best practices. We maintain a clear separation between design consultation and any physical implementation, allowing us to provide a service that is fully compliant with regulatory requirements. Our firm emphasizes strong project documentation, including detailed contracts and client approvals, to ensure accountability and clarity throughout each project. We pride ourselves on our commitment to client confidentiality and data privacy, utilizing secure digital storage systems and training our staff to handle sensitive information responsibly.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2022, a water leak occurred during the installation of a new kitchen backsplash, causing damage to the drywall and adjacent cabinetry. The estimated cost of repairs is $1,500. The claim has been settled, and repairs were completed on 09/30/2022.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: High-security safe, Class B, UL listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure fencing around the office perimeter to enhance safety and deter unauthorized access.

FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Elegant Spaces Interior Design has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. Everything is in good standing with our current insurance provider.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Elegant Spaces Interior Design does not lease employees to or from other employers; all staff are directly employed by the firm.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Elegant Spaces Interior Design does not currently have Workers Compensation coverage as all employees are directly employed, and operations are conducted in compliance with applicable regulations.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Elegant Spaces Interior Design also owns and operates Home Accents Boutique, which complements our interior design services by offering curated home decor items.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Elegant Spaces Interior Design does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. The current policy is sufficient to cover our operations and liabilities.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Elegant Spaces Interior Design is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our firm focuses solely on providing residential interior design and decoration services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Elegant Spaces Interior Design does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our focus is solely on providing interior design services without engaging in equipment rental. This approach ensures clarity in our operations and compliance with regulatory requirements.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Elegant Spaces Interior Design has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business remains in good financial standing.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Elegant Spaces Interior Design does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on residential interior design without handling such materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Elegant Spaces Interior Design does not have any catastrophe exposure as we exclusively focus on residential interior design, avoiding high-risk activities associated with catastrophes.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Elegant Spaces Interior Design has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The firm maintains a commitment to a respectful and inclusive environment in all its operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Elegant Spaces Interior Design does not have any uncorrected fire code violations and adheres to all relevant safety regulations.
